test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

My father took a moment to __ponder__ before signing the deeds of our ancestral home.
solution:
The correct answer is **Contemplate.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• “**Ponder**” means** “to think about something deeply**.”
 
• Therefore, “**Contemplate” **is the right word for it as it also means the same. (चिंतन करना)
 
 
• **Example: ***He loves to contemplate on philosophical questions on life.​*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***The meaning and usage of the other words are as follows:

 
• “**Hesitate**” means **having a dilemma over something. (**संकोच करना**)**

 
 
• **Example**: *He always hesitates when it comes to meeting a new client or appointing someone new to the company.*
 
 
 
• “**Sigh”** means **a long audible breath that expresses sadness. (**एक लंबी सुनाई देने वाली सांस जो दुख व्यक्त करती है)
 
 
• **Example:** *There is no sound except the sound of his sighs which express the deep pain in his heart.*
 
 
 
• “**Brief**” means **a small amount of something or a summary. (**संक्षिप्त**)**
 
 
• **Example**: *I will give you a brief overview of the work before you start working here.*
